requirement_text: The responsibility for the task of system-level definition of the coordinate systems and their inter-relationships, applicable to the whole product tree and to be used throughout the lifetime a project, shall be identified.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: The Coordinate Systems Document (CSD) shall be produced in conformance with Annex A.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: The CSD shall identify the specified coordinate systems and time scales used throughout the project, by two or more subsystems or organisations, together with their inter-relationships (in a parametric form).
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: For a spacecraft project, a preliminary version of the CSD shall be produced before the end of phase A.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: The CSD (and related database) shall be put under configuration control at the beginning of phase B.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: At each phase of the project, the coordinate systems and their inter- relationships shall be re-examined.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: The CSD shall include the new coordinate systems and transformations following the progress of the project development.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: The elements, which need coordinate systems, shall be identified.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: Each identified element of the system shall have its coordinate systems defined.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: A transformation chain structure shall be built to link coordinate systems used by two or more subsystems
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: The nominal value, in numeric or parametric form, of the transformation between two coordinate systems shall be specified.
basis: process/documentation requirement read for the tool's own frames

requirement_text: Applicable parts of the international standards and conventions listed in Annex C shall be selected and specified in the CSD.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Applicable non compliant external conventions shall be converted into the project's convention.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The conversion of 5.3.1b shall be specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: A coordinate system shall be identified by a unique descriptive name.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: A unique mnemonic shall be derived from the descriptive name of the coordinate system.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The transformation from one coordinate system to another shall be identified by a unique name, which also indicates the direction of the transformation.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The convention for naming coordinate systems and transformations shall be specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The notation convention shall be specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Sign conventions shall be identified and defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: A figure shall show the relationship of a coordinate system with equipment, spacecraft or mission.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The origin and axes of a coordinate frame shall be identified in figures using the reference mnemonic as indicated in 5.3.2c.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Symbols used within illustrations, figures and supporting diagrams shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: In an engineering drawing, the applicable projection system shall be indicated.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: In a 3D figure, the axes above, within and below a plane shall be differentiated.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The origin of the frame shall be specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The derivation of the origin of a frame from reference points shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The derivation of the axes of a frame from reference directions shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The axes of a frame shall be orthogonal.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The orientation of the axes of a frame shall be defined according to the right hand rule.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Any imported left handed frame shall be specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Any left handed frame shall be associated with a system reference right handed frame with the related transformation, for project development use.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The epoch of an inertial frame shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: If a coordinate system is time dependent, then its time scale shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The position of a point shall be definable by a set of coordinates with respect to a selected frame.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Dimensionless quantities shall be explicitly denoted as such.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The units or physical dimensions of all non-dimensionless parameters, including angles, shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The unit of time shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The relationship between all time scales used shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The frame for a mechanical system shall be related to its material structure definition.
basis: mechanical frames: only the body frame B and facets are defined

requirement_text: For alignment, integration and test purposes, the origin and axes of the coordinate systems shall be defined using physical and accessible points, including marks and targets.
basis: mechanical frames: only the body frame B and facets are defined

requirement_text: The process of constructing the origin and axes of a mechanical reference frame using the physical points shall be specified.
basis: mechanical frames: only the body frame B and facets are defined

requirement_text: The mathematical relationship between the coordinate system and physical points, as used in 5.4.5c above, shall be defined.
basis: mechanical frames: only the body frame B and facets are defined

requirement_text: The spacecraft interface frame w.r.t. its launcher adapter shall be specified.
basis: mechanical frames: only the body frame B and facets are defined

requirement_text: The specification of geodetic/planetocentric coordinates shall include the parameters of the ellipsoid used, direction and origin of longitude, and definition of the North Pole.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Any parameterisaton of a position or direction vector shall be specified mathematically.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Permitted parameterisations of a coordinate system shall be specified in the CSD.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: A transformation between coordinate systems shall be decomposed into a translational transformation and a rotational transformation, in a given order.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The order of decomposition of a transformation between coordinate systems shall be the same throughout a project.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: If rotation is composed of three elementary rotations, the order of rotations shall be specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Any left handed rotation convention shall be highlighted in the CSD.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: An elementary rotation shall be defined by a rotation axis and an angle.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: If the rotation is represented by a quaternion, the order and mathematical definition of the quaternion parameters shall be specified in the CSD.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The rotation error quaternion shall be expressed with a positive scalar part.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Any parameterisation of a rotation shall be specified as a matrix in terms of the parameters.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: If the rotation is represented by a 3x3 matrix, each matrix element shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: A transformation between coordinate systems shall be defined in the parent coordinate system in three ways: verbally, mathematically and graphically.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Any simplification of a transformation shall be specified, as well as its assumptions and validity.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The mathematical expression of the transformation between coordinate systems shall define the vector used for the translation, the method used for the rotation, and the order of the transformation.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The rows and columns of a transformation matrix shall be identified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The transformation between coordinate systems shall be defined by a mathematical expression relating the coordinates of a point in one frame with its coordinates in the other frame.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The numerical values of the elements of a rotation matrix shall be consistent with the precision required by the users of the data.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Any alternative representation of a rotation between coordinate systems shall be specified in its matrix representation.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The time dependency of a transformation between coordinate systems shall be defined.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: For time dependent transformations the method of interpolation shall be specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall describe the purpose, objective and the reason prompting its preparation (e.g. programme, project and phase).
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall list the applicable and reference documents supporting the generation of the document.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall specify the international conventions used within the project for coordinate systems and transformations.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall define the naming, notation and acronym rules for coordinate systems, as well as for transformations.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall define notation conventions for the transfer of coordinates and transformation data.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall specify the units pertaining to the coordinate systems and parameterisations used within the project.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall specify the time standards used within the project and shall specify the relationship between them.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall present the overview of the various coordinate systems.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The overview shall contain a brief description of at least the following coordinate systems, if applicable: 1. Inertial Coordinate Systems 2. Orbital Coordinate Systems 3. Launcher Coordinate Systems 4. Satellite-fixed Coordinate System (generic platform and payload) 5. Body-fixed Rotation (planet) Coordinate Systems 6. Topocentric Coordinate Systems 7. Test facility Coordinate Systems 8. Simulator Coordinate Systems 9. Processing / Product Coordinate Systems
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The description shall refer to the theory and conventions applied in between the various coordinate systems (e.g. precession, nutation, polar motion).
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall describe all parameterisations used within a coordinate system (e.g. azimuth, elevation), including the applicable type of coordinate systems where this parameterisation is allowed.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall describe all parameterisations used within a transformation (e.g. quaternions, Euler angles), including the applicable type of coordinate systems where this parameterisation is allowed.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall describe in a graphical representation the top-level chain of transformations for the project.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The diagram of <8a> shall include any additional constraints between coordinate systems, as well as measurements.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall describe in a graphical representation the lower level chains of transformations.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Each individual coordinate system, identified in <9> below, shall be graphically represented.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: These diagrams shall contain any additional constraints between coordinate systems, as well as measurements.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The CSD shall give the detailed description of all Coordinate Systems used in the project.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The transformation between coordinate systems shall be defined in the one that is the parent coordinate system.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Parameterisations within a coordinate system shall be identified and specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: The parameterisation of a transformation shall be identified and specified.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales

requirement_text: Any source document for a coordinate system shall be identified in the CSD.
basis: the tool defines and transforms frames and time scales
